text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED @oncall - production: gateway 5xx spike detected. 5xx rate = 11.8% over 5m, elevated latencies, multiple clients reporting timeouts. Alert rule: gateway.5xx_rate > 5% for 5m

sarah: saw it. watching grafana now: <https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/5xx-overview?orgId=1|grafana/5xx-overview>

ryan: confirm traffic spike from frontend -> us-east-1 gateway pool. p50 down, p95 up. traces show many upstream reset errors (RST_STREAM) and 503s from upstream cluster: model-serving-pool

ajay: paging in. on my way. what changed? any deploys in last 20m?

deploy-bot: deploy event: envoy-config-v3 rolled to 30% at 2026-01-27T18:05Z by ci/cd (sha: b3f7c2)

maria: noted. reaching out to CS for customer impact. alex-cs tagged.

alex-cs: getting customer reports — 3 enterprise customers reported failures in last 10m, some degrade to fallback. customer-facing status page set to "degraded".

sarah: looks like retry settings increased in new config: default_retries = 3 and per-route retry_budget enabled. suspect retry amplification + circuit-breaker thresholds too low -> overloaded upstreams, causing more 5xx.

ajay: pulling envoy admin stats from a box 
``` 
curl -sS http://localhost:9901/stats | egrep "cluster\.model-serving-pool|retry" | tail -n 50
# seeing high x_envoy_retry: 4xx+5xx retries and upstream_rq_5xx spikes
```

ajay: also ran `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep model-serving` — pods healthy but CPU saturating on a few hosts where retries concentrated

ryan: can we reduce retries or switch to failopen temporarily? need immediate mitigation before rollback.

sarah: mitigation plan: 1) patch envoy config to set per-route retries=0 for gateway routes -> reduce retry amplification 2) increase circuit-breaker max_requests and retry_budget.min_retry_concurrency on model-serving cluster 3) shift 20% traffic to secondary region (us-west-2) as short-term traffic bleed

ajay: I'll apply a quick patch to envoy config map and trigger a staged rollout to 0/50/100% for config. prepping kubectl patch now.

ajay: `kubectl patch configmap envoy-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data": {"routes.yaml": "...retries: 0..."}}'` (applied)

deploy-bot: configmap updated by ajay at 2026-01-27T18:18Z, rolling restart of envoy daemonsets starting

sarah: switching weight: `traffic-router update --service gateway --shift 20% --to-region us-west-2` (done). monitoring.

maria: CS: telling affected customers we've identified a config-induced retry storm and we're mitigating; ETA 10-15m for visible recovery.

ryan: watching errors: grafana panel shows 5xx down from 11.8% -> 6.2% after first patch. p95 latency improving slightly.

ajay: also bumped circuit breaker params on the cluster: `max_connections: 20000 -> 40000`, `max_pending`: 1000 -> 3000`. pushed via control plane.

sarah: good. note: this is a riskier knob long-term — we'll need followup to tune properly and add automated chaos-tolerant settings. add to runbook.

ajay: rolling envoys at 100% complete. verifying admin stats now. `curl http://localhost:9901/stats | grep upstream_rq_5xx` -> numbers dropping across nodes.

ryan: ok steady at ~3.1% 5xx across cluster, traffic bleed helped. customers reporting fewer errors.

maria: CS update posted to customers and status page. internal incident bridge open for postmortem: https://meet.redwood.com/incident/1768504321

alex-cs: customers appreciate quick comms. one enterprise asked for root cause timeline.

sarah: initial RCA: envoy config change at 18:05 unintentionally increased retries + enabled retry budget. under bursty traffic patterns this amplified to a retry storm hitting model-serving cluster causing resource exhaustion -> 5xx cascade. Mitigation: rollback retry changes (set retries=0), increase CB thresholds, shift traffic.

ajay: next steps (quick): 1) revert retries enablement from config repo (PR opened) 2) add automated canary checks for retry-related configs 3) add alert for retry amplification (retry:success > 30% of requests) 4) follow-up postmortem doc and owner (sarah + ajay)

deploy-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/infra/PR/5423 "revert: disable route retries until canary checks" by ajay

ryan: assign: oncall followup to sarah, infra changes owner ajay, CS followup maria, postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow.

sarah: thanks team. leaving incident channel open for 1hr of watch. will close when metrics stable for 30m and CS confirms no new reports. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 (customer-impacting). Timeline captured. Handoff to postmortem channel in 2 hours.

maria: customers updated, one enterprise asked for a compensatory credit — flagging to sales ops.

ryan: final note: add a test to evaluate retry budget interactions with short-lived upstreams in our integration suite.

ajay: ACK. collecting logs and saving /var/log/envoy-5xx-1768504321.tar.gz to s3://redwood-incident-archives/1768504321

sarah: closing active mitigation — metrics stable at 1.6% 5xx after 22 minutes. leaving ticket open for postmortem action items.

alex-cs: status page updated to "operational" at 2026-01-27T18:57Z. customers notified.

maria: closing channel for now, will DM owners for postmortem drafting.

sarah: good job everyone.
